title: The pullback of a descent datum along the diagonal is the identity
statement: Let $X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $V$ be a scheme over $X$, and let $\varphi:\mathrm{pr}_0^*V\to\mathrm{pr}_1^*V$ be a descent datum on $V$ over $X/Y$ [def-pd-descent-datum], where $\mathrm{pr}_0,\mathrm{pr}_1:X\times_YX\to X$ are the projections of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $\Delta:X\to X\times_YX$ be the diagonal, the morphism with $\mathrm{pr}_0\circ\Delta=\mathrm{pr}_1\circ\Delta=\mathrm{id}_X$. Since $\mathrm{pr}_k\circ\Delta=\mathrm{id}_X$, the pullbacks $\Delta^*\mathrm{pr}_0^*V$ and $\Delta^*\mathrm{pr}_1^*V$ are both canonically identified with $V$ as schemes over $X$; under these identifications the pullback $\Delta^*\varphi:V\to V$ of $\varphi$ along $\Delta$ equals $\mathrm{id}_V$.
